title: Erdős-Szekeres with Visibility
exact_target: Does every sufficiently large planar point set contain either many points on one line or a prescribed number of points with no other point blocking any connecting segment?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 131 (GREEN-043). CC BY 4.0.

Zachary Abel, Brad Ballinger, Prosenjit Bose, Sébastien Collette, Vida Dujmović, Ferran Hurtado, Scott D. Kominers, Stefan Langerman, Attila Pór and David R. Wood, \emph{Every Large Point Set Contains Many Collinear Points or an Empty Pentagon}, Graphs and Combinatorics 27 (2011), 47--60, §1.4, Conjecture 4.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author list, Problem 70 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
